lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Okay, end of day. Quick recap before I forget all of it.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: The Ducal Freight call went well. Paris wants three things: inspections that sync when they're back online, a signed PDF for every inspection, and export to their freight system by site. The first two we can show Friday. Export is later, and I need to give him real timing.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Big one: versioning's decided. Romeo and I agreed Capulet owns the inspection record, Montague owns the routing envelope, and any change needs both of us to sign off. He's adding a schema version number to every event.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: So, um, tonight or first thing tomorrow, fill in that empty owner line in the spec. Then it goes in Friday's note to Friar. He asked for exactly this, so he'll be happy.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: And, ugh, the Paris flight. The trade show, on the twenty-sixth. I still haven't booked it. Book the flight, Juliet.
